caption: A source folder with three Zim pages, mapped paths and reported sections.
eval: (async()=>{const p = app.plugins.plugins['zim-notebook-import']; window.__zimModal?.close(); app.setting.close();p.pro.signOut(); const old=app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Demo import'); if(old) await app.vault.delete(old,true); const m=p.openImport(); m.contentEl.querySelector('[aria-label="Source folder"]').value='Zim Notebook Import/Source'; m.contentEl.querySelector('[aria-label="Source folder"]').dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); m.contentEl.querySelector('[aria-label="New destination folder"]').value='Demo import'; m.contentEl.querySelector('[aria-label="New destination folder"]').dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await m.review();window.__zimModal=m; return 'ok';})()

caption: Headings, lists, tasks, emphasis, code and mapped page links in the imported garden note.
eval: (async()=>{const p = app.plugins.plugins['zim-notebook-import']; window.__zimModal?.close(); app.setting.close();if(!app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath('Demo import')) await p.writeImport(await p.prepare('Zim Notebook Import/Source','Demo import')); await app.workspace.getLeaf().openFile(app.vault.getFileByPath('Demo import/Project.md')); return 'ok';})()

caption: Pro saves a source folder with flat output and hyphenated page names.
eval: (async()=>{const p = app.plugins.plugins['zim-notebook-import']; window.__zimModal?.close(); app.setting.close();p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('zim-notebook-import-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();await p.saveRules('Zim Notebook Import/Source','Later garden import',{folders:'flat',names:'hyphens'}); window.__zimModal=p.openImport(); return 'ok';})()

caption: Pro compares changed source text with the first import.
eval: (async()=>{const p = app.plugins.plugins['zim-notebook-import']; window.__zimModal?.close(); app.setting.close();p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('zim-notebook-import-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();const f=app.vault.getFileByPath('Zim Notebook Import/Source/Project.txt'); window.__zimSource=await app.vault.read(f); await app.vault.modify(f,window.__zimSource+'\nNew planting date: next Saturday.\n'); const changes=await p.laterPreview(); const m=p.openImport(); window.__zimModal=m; m.showChanges(changes); return 'ok';})()
